BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1, Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-G in the area bounded by

The alley next north of and parallel to West Farragut Avenue; a line

273.45 feet east of and parallel to North Clark Street; West Farragut

Avenue; and a line 248.45 feet east of and parallel to North Clark Street;

to those of an RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1464 West Farragut Avenue
